% the app's DB is not mounted; /etc/hostname is the container's own
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\IfFileExists{/data/overtree.db}{\typeout{DB=READABLE}\input{/data/overtree.db}}{\typeout{DB=MISSING}DB missing.}
\newread\hostfile
\openin\hostfile=/etc/hostname
\read\hostfile to\hostname
\closein\hostfile
\typeout{HOSTNAME=\hostname}
Host: \input{/etc/hostname}
\end{document}
